answer: When an agent joins the web‑of‑trust, it must stake an onyx‑token and receive a plume of vouches from three existing nodes, each recording the new ID in a signed ledger entry. The ledger ties each voucher’s reputation to a tide‑weighted decay: if any vouched identity is later proven fake, all its vouches lose standing and the staked tokens are slashed. An attacker therefore pays a minimum of 3 onyx‑tokens per fake ID, plus a 48‑hour lockup before the ID becomes usable.
